_meta.pack: Lepa Svaki Dan v2 content pack

conventions.html:
Fields named *Html / html contain only (= the old "font-display-italic text-lila" accent word), , and
. Entities are kept as in the source (&). Inline styles were stripped.
conventions.text:
Plain-text twins of html fields. "\n" marks an old
.
conventions.derived: Fields listed under "Derived fields" in MANIFEST.md were computed from source data; everything else is verbatim.
conventions.locationCodes: service.location: nb = Beauty Concept Novi Beograd, bw = Wellbeing Concept Belgrade Waterfront, both = obe. verticals[].location uses beauty/wellbeing/both.
conventions.noSourceValue: null = the old site has no such value (blog date, offer old price/validity, map URLs, per-location hours). Do not invent one.
conventions.ids: Service ids are "<tabId>:<groupIndex>:<serviceIndex>" (0-based, source order). Names are NOT unique.
conventions.imagePaths: Image paths are relative to the OLD site folder (assets/images/...). images{} lists absolute paths on disk.

warnings: Vertical "Tretmani lica" states "18 tretmana" but cenovnik data has 58 services in tab "lice" (old site text kept verbatim).
Vertical "Tretmani tela" states "12 tretmana" but cenovnik data has 36 services in tab "telo" (old site text kept verbatim).
Vertical "Estetske procedure" states "22 procedure" but cenovnik data has 62 services in tab "estetske" (old site text kept verbatim).
Vertical "Posebni protokoli" states "10 paketa" but cenovnik data has 26 services in tab "protokoli" (old site text kept verbatim).

4 blog posts still contain "________" blanks in the body (device/doctor name the client must fill): Laserska dermatologija Candela laserima | Klasična dermatologija: Šta obuhvata dermatološki pregled? | Radiotalasno uklanjanje promena na koži | PRP i mezoterapija: Tretmani skalpa za pospešivanje rasta kose. Blog is teaser-only in v2, but never show those bodies.
FAVORITES_PICKS and GIFT_PICKS are marked in the old source as a SAMPLE selection ("Tamara će dostaviti finalnu listu"); the final list from the client is still pending.
Source inconsistency kept verbatim: "Banka Intesa" (price-list footnote) vs "Banca Intesa" (payment modal).

Blog title "Preime Dermafacial: Napredna tehnologija za sofisticirano podmlađivanje kože" looks like a typo ("Preime", probably "Premium"); kept verbatim. It is also the SERVICE_BLOG_LINKS key for the Dermafacial services, so any correction must be made in both places.
Source typo kept verbatim: "orjentacionog" (payment modal; correct spelling is "orijentacionog").
Novi Beograd phone is formatted two ways in the old site: "+381 64 8239 439" (nav/CTA/footer/pricing) and "+381 64 823 9439" (coin card). Both kept (phone.display / phone.displayCoin).
YouTube footer link has no URL in the old site (href="#"); contact.social[].href is null for it. Do not render it as a working link.
No map URLs, no per-location opening hours, no postal codes in the old site; locations[].mapUrl/hours and contact.mapUrls are null. Only global hours exist: "Pon — Sub · 9—21h".

Offers have no old price, validity period or per-offer CTA URL in the old site (oldPrice/validity are null; every CTA is the shared Novi Beograd WhatsApp link). Blog posts have no date or slug (date is null; slug/anchor are derived).
Old pricing data has no duration field; only 3 services state a duration in their name ("N min"), exposed as service.duration. Do not invent others.
3 laser rows carry highlight:true in the data, but the old UI never renders a badge on laser rows.
4 service names occur in more than one group with possibly different prices (e.g. "Ruke", "Butine i zadnjica", "Celo telo"); always address services by id (tab:group:index), never by name alone.

about.title: Lepota nije trenutak, već navika.
paragraphs: Lepa Svaki Dan je nastala iz uverenja da prava nega kože i tela ne traži kompromis, samo posvećenost. Spojili smo aparaturnu medicinu i klasičnu estetiku pod jedan krov, sa timom koji vas prati od prve konsultacije do vidljivog rezultata.
Dve lokacije u Beogradu, jedna filozofija: svaki tretman je planiran, ne improvizovan. Jer lepota koju gradite zaslužuje pažnju, svaki dan.

displayRules: service.location (nb/bw/both) is intentionally NOT shown per service on the old site (client decision, comment in old index.html / izmene.txt). Keep it in data; do not render a per-service location pill without client sign-off. (The 5 treatment categories in verticals[] DO show a location badge on the old site.)
Laser tab shows ONE merged price per row (unified price: the lower of NB/BW prefixed "od ", or the only available price). priceNB/priceBW stay in data only.
highlight=true renders the badge "💜 akcija" on standard rows. Laser rows carry a highlight flag the old UI never rendered.
Services whose name contains "higijenski" or "dermafacial" are linked to a blog post (service.blogPost = post title; see blog[] / serviceBlogLinks).
Group header shows "<N> usluga". Old UI opens the first group of a tab by default; one group open at a time.

testimonials.quote: Posle prve konsultacije dr Tamara mi je dala plan koji nije samo radio, već sam u njemu osetila pažnju. Sada svaki tretman doživljavam kao ritual, ne obavezu.
testimonials.author: Jovana M.

testimonials.quote: Probala sam mnoge tretmane, ali ovde se prvi put osećam kao da neko stvarno gleda moju kožu. Profhilo paket mi je u potpunosti vratio sjaj.
testimonials.author: Marija K.

testimonials.quote: Najviše me osvojio profesionalizam. Bez prodaje, bez pritiska, samo iskreni saveti i tretmani koji rade. Otkad sam tu, ne idem nigde drugde.
testimonials.author: Ana T.

testimonials.quote: Stalno mi prijateljice pitaju gde idem na tretmane. Wellbeing Concept na Waterfront-u mi je oaza nakon posla, i koža i glava se odmore.
testimonials.author: Mirjana V.
